en.badr-shahin: Al-Hasan bin Ahmed, Allah may have mercy upon him, narrated from… al-Mufaddhal that

Abu Abdullah (a) said: Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, has created all the believers from the same origin. No one is added to them and no one of them is excluded. By Allah (I swear), they are like a head for a body and fingers for a hand. If you notice anyone unlike this description, you should know that he is hypocrite.
